title: Teenage girl arrested for planning the massive shooting at the Indiana School that raised money to save her life
text:
By Germania Rodriguez poleo, main reporter of the US.
Published: 20:01 GMT, February 13, 2025 | Updated: 21:20 GMT, February 13, 2025
A teenage girl is accused of planning a massive shooting in Valentine’s Day at her school.
Trinity Shockley, 18, was arrested on Tuesday in Mooresville, Indiana, and accused of conspiracy to commit murder and commit threatening terrorism in addition to other violations.
She would plan a shooting at Mooresville High School on Friday.
The police say they received a tip on Tuesday evening about her alleged plans, as reported by Fox 59 .
Local police and the FBI performed a house search order in her house the same night.
Allegedly they found proof that she was planting a massive shooting before she took her in custody.
She is held in the prison of Morgan County without a band.
Shockley was earlier in the news after being hit by a suspected drunk driver when she crossed the street in 2022.

Mooresville schools saw money for her recovery at that time. She suffered from a broken thigh, broken arm, sprained ACL, two brain contusions and a web compressive fracture.
After the accident, her aunt Angela Altmeyer Fox 59 told that Shockley was a ‘fun, loving girl’.
“She’s extrovert. She just wants to go, go, go. She is always on the road, “said Altmeyer in 2022.
The teenager lives with her single father Tim, who spent 19 years in the army before taking a medical leave.
Altmeyer said that the father and daughter were ‘best friends’.
In a goofundme for the family, Altmayer explained that the couple had started in the city of Indiana before the accident ‘just a new life’.
